changed_in.5.3: `t1` is required. 5.1 and 5.2 take it as `0` when it is left out, so `os.difftime(stamp)` measures from whatever moment `0` names there. Both arguments also have to be whole numbers inside the range a time value can hold, where earlier versions accept any number and truncate a fraction. This is also where the result stops matching a plain subtraction in kind: `os.time` begins answering with an integer, so `finish - start` becomes integer arithmetic while this call still answers with a float, and one duration prints as `30600` where the other prints as `30600.0`. 5.1 and 5.2 have only one number type, so there the two spellings are the same and both read `30600`.
